toolsets.name: asset
toolsets.description: The asset system - search, inspect, compile, edit and preview the project's assets

toolsets.name: bridge_asset
toolsets.description: Search the local asset library and sbox.game cloud assets, install packages, inspect asset metadata, copy assets with their dependency closure, and recompile assets.

toolsets.name: bridge_audio
toolsets.description: List sounds, author .sound events, attach sound components, and preview audio in the editor.

toolsets.name: bridge_batch
toolsets.description: Bulk operations across many GameObjects in one call, with dry-run validation before applying. Get target ids from find_objects or get_selected_objects.

toolsets.name: bridge_character
toolsets.description: Spawn and outfit citizen characters, pose and animate them, play animations, set animgraph parameters, ragdolls, lipsync, and attachments.

toolsets.name: bridge_component
toolsets.description: Add, configure, inspect and invoke components on GameObjects: set/get properties, wire cross-component references, call methods and editor buttons.

toolsets.name: bridge_debug
toolsets.description: Bridge health, editor restart, console commands, profiler stats, time scale, debug draw primitives (lines, boxes, spheres), and editor camera framing.

toolsets.name: bridge_discovery
toolsets.description: Reflect over the s&box API: describe types, search types, get method signatures, list installed libraries, and search project files. Use before writing C# against unfamiliar SDK types.

toolsets.name: bridge_gameobject
toolsets.description: GameObject lifecycle, hierarchy, transforms, tags, selection, and bulk layout (align, distribute, scatter, snap-to-ground, grid duplicate) in the open scene. Objects are referenced by GUID from get_scene_hierarchy or find_objects.

toolsets.name: bridge_helpers
toolsets.description: Claude Bridge convenience helpers over native MCP. Prefer the engine's scene, asset, Hammer and UI tools for ordinary editor work.

toolsets.name: bridge_material
toolsets.description: Assign models and materials to renderers, author .vmat materials, and set material properties.

toolsets.name: bridge_moviemaker
toolsets.description: Wire and control Sandbox.MovieMaker cutscene playback: list .movie clips, add MoviePlayer components, play and stop clips.

toolsets.name: bridge_navigation
toolsets.description: Bake the navmesh and query walkable paths.

toolsets.name: bridge_networking
toolsets.description: Multiplayer setup, local multi-instance testing, and codegen: network helpers, lobby managers, networked players, [Sync] properties, RPCs (broadcast/host/targeted), ownership, spawning, and host-migration recovery.

toolsets.name: bridge_npc
toolsets.description: NPC brains (state machines), spawners, patrol routes, and perception simulation.

toolsets.name: bridge_physics
toolsets.description: Rigidbodies, colliders, joints, raycasts and overlap queries in the open scene.

toolsets.name: bridge_playmode
toolsets.description: Enter/exit play mode, check play state, and read/write component properties on live runtime objects while playing.

toolsets.name: bridge_playtest
toolsets.description: Scripted gameplay verification in play mode: run step lists with in-frame assertions (playtest), drive the player controller, and simulate input actions.

toolsets.name: bridge_prefab
toolsets.description: Create prefabs from scene objects, instantiate them, list and inspect them, and wire prefab references into component properties.

toolsets.name: bridge_project
toolsets.description: Project info and config (.sbproj), file read/write, C# script create/edit/delete, hotload, input actions, and publishing metadata.

toolsets.name: bridge_scaffold_gameplay
toolsets.description: Generate complete, compile-verified gameplay C# components: player/NPC controllers, game managers, health, pickups, inventory, save systems, economy, loot tables, round/phase machines, interaction systems, placement mode, and more. Each tool writes a .cs file into the project; follow with trigger_hotload + compile_status.

toolsets.name: bridge_scaffold_polish
toolsets.description: Generate game-feel and presentation components: camera shake, flickering lights, floating combat text, combo meters, nametags, world-panel UIs, cutscene directors, and dialogue systems.

toolsets.name: bridge_scene
toolsets.description: Create and load scene files in the s&box editor. For saving/listing scenes use the built-in scene toolset (save_scene, list_scenes).

toolsets.name: bridge_screenshot
toolsets.description: Capture inline PNG images from the main camera, framed/free viewpoints, object orbits, saved session camera bookmarks, ordered comparison sets, or a deterministic orthographic top-down view. Works in edit and play mode; temporary cameras are removed after every capture.

toolsets.name: bridge_ui
toolsets.description: Generate Razor UI panels: screen-space HUDs, world-space panels, and custom PanelComponent scaffolds.

toolsets.name: bridge_validation
toolsets.description: Lint and validate the project: networking footguns, sandbox whitelist violations, Razor transpiler footguns, scene setup issues, publishing readiness, save-file inspection, and networked-object state dumps.

toolsets.name: bridge_vehicle
toolsets.description: Make things drivable: generate raycast-car controllers with built-in driver seats, standalone enter/exit seats, and physgun-style grab tools; apply arcade/drift/offroad/race handling presets to any vehicle component. Attach the generated components with batch_add_component; verify by driving in play mode.

toolsets.name: bridge_visuals
toolsets.description: Lighting, fog, post-processing, skyboxes, envmap probes, particles (.vpcf), and one-call atmosphere/look presets.

toolsets.name: bridge_workflow
toolsets.description: Agent workflow safety net: snapshot the whole scene to temp storage before risky changes (checkpoint_scene), browse snapshots (list_checkpoints), and roll the scene back (restore_checkpoint). The undo story for bridge mutations while the engine's snapshot API stays addon-inaccessible.

toolsets.name: bridge_world
toolsets.description: Terrain sculpting, hills, trails and clearings; forest painting and POIs; cave paths; and path-based object placement. Requires MapBuilder/ForestGenerator-style components in the project (invoke_button works anywhere).

toolsets.name: component
toolsets.description: Component type documentation - what components exist and what properties they expose

toolsets.name: hammer
toolsets.description: Hammer, the map editor - find and inspect map nodes, place entities, game objects and brush geometry, assign materials, run Hammer commands, move the camera and screenshot the map

toolsets.name: instance
toolsets.description: Tool discovery and recent console output

toolsets.name: log
toolsets.description: Write messages to the editor console

toolsets.name: network
toolsets.description: Multiplayer from the editor - host a lobby, spawn local client instances, watch connections and trigger a host handoff

toolsets.name: package
toolsets.description: Published packages on the sbox.game backend - search and fetch details

toolsets.name: perf
toolsets.description: Performance numbers from the dev tools (devtools): frame times, what limits the frame rate, CPU scopes, GPU passes, memory and GC, rendering counters, network and UI costs

toolsets.name: play
toolsets.description: Play mode - start, stop and pause the game

toolsets.name: publishing
toolsets.description: Preview publishing rules, runtime-content warnings and dependency costs without saving project settings.

toolsets.name: scene
toolsets.description: Open scenes - the game object hierarchy, creating and editing game objects and components, the editor camera and viewport screenshots

toolsets.name: scenefile
toolsets.description: Opening, switching and closing scene tabs

toolsets.name: ui
toolsets.description: Live UI - panel tree, computed styles, matched rules, screenshots, hit testing, text metrics, and probing css without editing a file
